title: 3-story Townhome GREAT location
description:
Your ideal East Nashville hideaway, this townhome boasts an all-suite layout, an immaculate kitchen, and a private top-floor balcony. Find a spacious and well-furnished suite on each floor, both of which are appointed with a smart TV and an en-suite bathroom. East Nashville offers a charming blend of historic homes, hip boutiques, and trending eateries-- many within walking distance! To discover a rich music and art scene, travel less than 10 minutes to downtown, the Gulch, or Music Row.

The space
On the first floor you have an open floor plan; living room, full kitchen, and a half bath.

The second floor boasts a massive bedroom with 2 queen beds, a walk-in closet, and a full bathroom.

The top floor is the master suite with full master bathroom and private roof-top patio.

Fully furnished with all linens and towels included!

Other things to note
Townhome complex requires gated entry.

The home uses smart locks and thermostats.
